title: tc-pr-link
description:
A pull request in running text – its state's mark and owner/repo#number · title as a link, with a card of its state,
author, lines changed and files on hover or focus.

href.description: Where the link goes; without one it's text with the card, not a link

avatar.description: The author's picture URL; without one the card shows initials

updatedAt.description: When it last changed state (opened, merged, closed), epoch ms

now.description: The time now, epoch ms; by default the element's own clock when the card opens

compact.description: Just the mark and #number, without the repository and title

newTab.description: Open the link in a new tab

hoverDelay.description: How long the pointer rests on the link before the card opens, ms

locale.description: The language for numbers and times, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

labels.description: The words it uses, to translate or reword
